backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date; paper entry is next available open with production entry slippage; exit is the close ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The high-close route uses only signal-day OHLCV known after that close and before next-open paper entry. No future price path, LLM judgment, or hidden production-only field is used.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV Close rows for signal-day and trailing relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. This is default-off paper candidate routing, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: same-industry leadership breakouts are more likely to add replacement value when the signal day closes near its own high, which is a free OHLCV demand-quality field.

2_history_check.exp-20260527-022: Raw industry-leadership breadth breakout had positive aggregate EV/PnL but failed Gate 4 because late_strong regressed.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-032: Sector-breadth closed-ledger governor stayed positive in aggregate but still failed late_strong.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-034: No-core-overlap industry-leadership improved mid_weak and old_thin but failed late_strong and concentration.
2_history_check.positive_field_analogs: VBB signal-day high-close support and Space trend high-close routing were recently useful on separate paper surfaces, but this run fixes the threshold at 0.70 instead of mining a new sweep.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same docs/backtesting.md three windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; target concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: Industry-leadership breadth breakout candidates may have cleaner replacement value when the signal day closes in the upper 30% of its own intraday range. The source candidate definition, ranking, paper notional, hold period, execution model, core stack, LLM/news replay, and live orders stay fixed.
interpretation: The industry-leadership high-close route did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby close-location/industry-overlap variants on these frozen windows without forward paper rows or a materially different production-visible field.
next_evidence_needed: If revisited, use a materially new discriminator such as source/event confirmation or forward paper rows; do not just retune the same OHLCV thresholds on this frozen sample.

locked_variables: paper notional, next-open entry, and ten-trading-day exit

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A positive result cannot be retained as strategy behavior until the same route is implemented in a shared default-off paper adapter, surfaced by production, and covered by parity tests.
